messages:
marco: dropped a prototype screenshot in here for the compact min/max control when burst is enabled. want feedback on density and labels.

anya: layout looks cleaner. my worry is the condensed labels: 'Min' and 'Max' alone might be ambiguous for new users. can we add a tooltip or small caption 'concurrent GPUs'?

sam: +1. also when burst toggles on, the stepper becomes visible but there's no aria-live announcement. screen readers won't notice the new control.

keisha: visual nit: the burst tag uses a pale green bg and white text — contrast is low. propose we flip to dark green text on pale green bg or add an outline.

marco: noted. for captions I was thinking 'Min (concurrent workers)'. is that too verbose?

anya: that's clearer. maybe use 'Min (workers)' to keep it short but helpful.

sam: keyboard behavior: tabbing into the min/max fields should allow arrow key adjustments, but in the prototype arrow keys scroll the page. need preventDefault on keydown.

keisha: copy question for the SLO slider tooltip: current draft: 'Target p95 latency'. Users asked in research to see the unit. change to 'Target p95 latency (ms)'.

marco: good catch. also we should show a tiny indicator if the selected SLO is incompatible with the selected pool (e.g., premium SLO with low-tier pool). maybe a subtle yellow triangle with tooltip 'May exceed pool throughput'.

anya: prefer explicit text: the triangle is easy to miss for low-vision users. can we show 'Potential throughput mismatch' inline and link to suggestions: 'Use burst or upgrade pool'.

sam: accessibility: ensure the mismatch message becomes part of the form validation and is announced on change. aria-live polite.

keisha: regarding the min/max stepper increments — research suggests 1 GPU steps are fine up to 8 GPUs, then jump to 2+. propose step heuristic: step=1 if value<8 else 2.

marco: we have to be careful with autoscale min set too high. maybe add guardrail modal if min > 32 or min > 0.6 * pool_capacity.

anya: yes, show inline warning 'High minimum may increase costs' and offer a suggested lower bound computed by optimizer.

sam: QA note: the burst on/off state should persist in URL query params for deep linking. right now it resets on refresh.

qa-bot: lint: color-contrast fail on .burst-tag; missing keyboard focus visible on info buttons; form validation messages not in ARIA-live region.

marco: summary of actions I'll take: add '(workers)' caption to Min/Max labels, implement aria-live for dynamic controls, adjust burst tag colors to pass AA, add explicit mismatch text and link, implement step heuristic, and add guardrail modal triggers. will post updated Figma frame as 2100123468.

keisha: for copy final: Min (workers), Max (workers), SLO: Target p95 latency (ms). Mismatch hint: 'Potential throughput mismatch — consider burst or upgrade pool.'

anya: +1. thanks team, this looks much better. I'll run an a11y pass after the update.

sam: once Marco pushes changes, I'll test keyboard/arrow interactions and confirm no page scroll.

qa-bot: reminder: attach screenshots for color contrast verifier when you update.

marco: will do. thanks all :heart:
